# External datasets

Put datasets downloaded from the internet here (git-ignored except this file) and analyse them
with `scripts/analyze_dataset.m` or the app's "Open dataset…" button. Formats and the privacy
rules applied on import: docs/DATASET_IMPORT.md. Check each dataset's licence and terms first.

Network-traffic datasets (CTU-13, CIC-IDS2017, UNSW-NB15, LANL): which files to download and
how they are read — docs/NETWORK_DATASETS.md.
